posts.title: Dismantling Weight Bias in Eating Disorder Treatment: How to Support Patients in Large Bodies

items.summary_en: A free 90-minute live webinar from Equip Academy, presented by clinical psychologist Dr. Savannah Erwin and Ally Duvall. It explains why weight bias harms eating disorder care: fewer than 6% of people with eating disorders are underweight, yet people in larger bodies are often undiagnosed, misdiagnosed, or stigmatised when they seek help. The session covers three common weight myths and their dangers, key considerations when caring for larger-bodied patients, and strategies to help patients embrace weight inclusivity. Held Tuesday 1 December 2026, 11:30-13:00 Pacific Time (14:30-16:00 Eastern; 03:30-05:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 2 December), live online via TPN.health with on-demand replay, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. Full attendance earns CE credit. Aimed at physicians, nurses, dietitians, psychologists, social workers, marriage and family therapists, addiction counsellors and other healthcare providers.

posts.title: Introductory Webinar - FASD-Informed Care: Striving for Equity

items.summary_en: A free 60-minute introductory webinar from the Florida Center Training Institute, presented by clinical psychologist Dr. Christie Petrenko. It introduces FASD-informed care: what fetal alcohol spectrum disorders (FASD) are, how a diagnosis helps children and families, and the practical principles of FASD-informed care. Dr. Petrenko also introduces FMF Connect Pro, an app-based tool to support provider competence, and invites professionals to join an upcoming research cohort. Held Tuesday 15 December 2026, 12:00-13:00 Eastern Time (01:00-02:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 16 December), live on Zoom, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. One free CEU is available for psychologists, social workers, marriage and family therapists and mental health counsellors. Designed for professionals working with children aged 3-13 with FASD or prenatal alcohol exposure.
